# Claude LinkedIn

Claude LinkedIn is a free, open-source collection of eight Agent Skills for running a stateful organic LinkedIn content and engagement campaign in Claude Code and Codex. Its technical repository and plugin identifier remain LinkedIn Campaign Operator.

Primary documentation:
- /install — Claude Code and Codex installation
- /skills — the eight-skill system map
- /examples — practical prompts and workflows
- /docs — configuration, state, and architecture
- /press — product facts and founder story
- /blog/launch — launch article

Source: https://github.com/sunny-chandel/linkedin-campaign-operator
License: MIT
Creator: Sunny Chandel
